name: health-code
description: Try dependency upgrades on your code in a Runta sandbox and get tested patches for what breaks

scripts.build: rm -f .tsbuild/publish.tsbuildinfo && mkdir -p dist && find dist -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name cli -exec rm -rf {} + && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun build guest/project.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/project.mjs && bun build guest/observe.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/observe.mjs && bun build guest/agent.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/agent.mjs && bun build guest/managePatch.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/patch.mjs && bun build guest/nodeTestReporter.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/nodeTestReporter.mjs
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run --cwd ../../apps/cli build
